title: Reading Drill — Checking a new market awning — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Checking a new market awning — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The market buildings team in Hillswick received an old report about water dripping at one end onto a busy walkway. The report compared the area wetted during showers, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the chalk outlines rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered seven weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include wind during rain. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a slight change in the angle as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
